name: Sabudana khichdi (tapioca pearls with peanuts and potato)

source.name: Swasthi's Recipes (indianhealthyrecipes.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 2. 1 cup sabudana taken as 160 g dry pearls; 1/4 cup peanuts 36 g (roasted, salted); 2 tbsp ghee 26 g; 1 medium boiled potato 150 g (peeled); 1.5 green chilies 7 g; 1/2 tsp rock salt 3 g as table salt; 1/2 tsp sugar 2 g; 1 tbsp lemon juice 15 g; 2 tbsp coriander leaves 2 g. Curry leaves omitted (not in catalog); optional ginger and coconut left out. The 3/4 cup (180 g) soaking water is fully absorbed by the pearls and counted as water; about 5% is lost as steam while stir-frying.

ingredients.food: Potatoes, boiled, cooked without skin, flesh, without salt
